items.title: Mike Schreiner, MPP Green Party of Ontario and Bobby Ann Brady,
notes: MPP for Haldimand-Norfolk appeared to speak to their proposal to introduce legislation to protect Ontario’s farmland through the creation of a “Foodbelt”. He indicated protecting Ontario farmlands through the establishment of an “Ontario Food Belt' would help create the conditions for economic prosperity through enhanced food security and food sovereignty during times of economic tariffs. It also ensures Ontario's Agri- Food industry will continue to thrive and improve the health and wellness of the community.
Mayor Watters thanked M. Schreiner and Bobby Ann Brady and the following was put forward:

items.title: Lianne Cater, Director, Elora Centre for the Arts provided an update
notes: regarding the renovations to the Centre. She indicated the funds received from the Jack R. MacDonald fund were used to build accessible washrooms, reinstate three heritage windows at the south end of the building and construct a new accessible entrance. L. Carter noted the project is nearing completion with an official grand opening planned for early in the new year.

items.title: Erika Montero, former Chair of the Elora BIA, requested Council not
notes: support the Elora Green Space Lighting proposal. She indicated the project was privately funded for only 1 year and feels taxpayers should not have to financial support this project. She also noted the environmental impact of the excessive illumination.

items.title: Cathy Daultrey, business owner appeared before Council in objection to
notes: the Elora Green Space Lighting proposal. She suggested the lights could be used throughout the Township of Centre Wellington and not only in the Elora Green Space.

items.title: Maclean Hann, Chair Elora BIA, noted after learning of the loss of the
notes: private donor to fund the lighting of the green space, the Elora BIA worked on communicating and building consensus from the business catchment area whether to support lighting in the Green Space, recognizing the significance of creating a seasonal atmosphere and promoting tourism and economic development. He noted he was able to garner feedback from the businesses and indicated the Board meets next week where a wholesome discussion will take place to consider funding a portion of the project this year and to perhaps find a sustainable mechanism for funding in future years.

motions.item_title: Mike Schreiner, MPP Green Party of Ontario and Bobby Ann Brady,
motions.text: WHEREAS, Ontario farmers produce a wide variety of nutritious and safe food for both domestic and export markets; WHEREAS, Ontario, and Centre Wellington in particular, is home to some of the highest quality agricultural lands and optimal agri-climatic conditions and Ontario is currently losing approximately 319 acres (130 hectares) of farmland every day; WHEREAS, we need to acknowledge that food security and food sovereignty are both critical from a national security perspective and noting Food Security is the ability of individuals to receive adequate nourishment while Food Sovereignty refers to the ability of a country to supply its own food needs; WHEREAS, MPP’s Bobbi Ann Brady and Mike Schreiner have jointly presented a Private Member Bill at the Ontario Legislature to protect Ontario farmlands through the establishment of an ‘Ontario Food Belt. WHEREAS, the Bill would make farmlands within a designated Food belt permanently protected from development; WHEREAS, the Bill is supported by the Ontario Farmland Trust, the Ontario Federation of Agriculture, the Christian Farmers and the National Farmers Union; THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED THAT: (a) THAT the Township of Centre Wellington gives it’s support to the Bill’s intent for the Province of Ontario, to create an agricultural working group to more fully outline the contours of an Ontario Food Belt; (b) That the Township of Centre Wellington request, through our representative at the Rural Ontario Municipalities Association (ROMA), that ROMA support this Bill; and, (c) That this decision be circulated to all other lower tier municipalities in Wellington County as well as to the County of Wellington.
motions.text_html:
WHEREAS, Ontario farmers produce a wide variety of nutritious and safe food for both domestic and export markets; WHEREAS, Ontario, and Centre Wellington in particular, is home to some of the highest quality agricultural lands and optimal agri-climatic conditions and Ontario is currently losing approximately 319 acres (130 hectares) of farmland every day; WHEREAS, we need to acknowledge that food security and food sovereignty are both critical from a national security perspective and noting Food Security is the ability of individuals to receive adequate nourishment while Food Sovereignty refers to the ability of a country to supply its own food needs; WHEREAS, MPP’s Bobbi Ann Brady and Mike Schreiner have jointly presented a Private Member Bill at the Ontario Legislature to protect Ontario farmlands through the establishment of an ‘Ontario Food Belt. WHEREAS, the Bill would make farmlands within a designated Food belt permanently protected from development; WHEREAS, the Bill is supported by the Ontario Farmland Trust, the Ontario Federation of Agriculture, the Christian Farmers and the National Farmers Union; THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED THAT:

(a) THAT the Township of Centre Wellington gives it’s support to the Bill’s intent for the Province of Ontario, to create an agricultural working group to more fully outline the contours of an Ontario Food Belt;

(b) That the Township of Centre Wellington request, through our representative at the Rural Ontario Municipalities Association (ROMA), that ROMA support this Bill; and,

(c) That this decision be circulated to all other lower tier municipalities in Wellington County as well as to the County of Wellington.
